Content:
FINER slice on CreatureCreator (D:\UnityProjects\CreatureCreator) definition MUTATION / CLONE / HIERARCHY semantics + the VALIDATION surface. Namespace: ProceduralCreature.Definition. Complements (not duplicates) the coarse records creaturecreator-definition-model / creaturecreator-architecture-and-invariants. Every material claim is classified inline: Confirmed = verified in source AND a test; Inference = source-supported but not directly test-asserted (or a reasonable reading). All paths repo-relative under Assets/.

## 1. Mutation boundary & deep clone

- CreatureDefinition is the single authoritative model. All edits to it funnel through ONE mutation path at the editor layer (CreatureEditorWindow.MutateDefinition): every field edit CLONES the current definition, applies the edit to the scratch copy, and only becomes canonical state after DefinitionValidator passes (README.md ~375-407). GUI code never assigns directly into the window's _definition. Confirmed (source CreatureDefinition.cs docstring cites guide SS16 'one mutation path'; README lines 375-407).
- CreatureDefinition.Clone() is a DEEP clone: it copies SchemaVersion, SymmetryMode, Bounds, Generation, Forward, clones Body via Body.Clone(), and re-clones each part via CreaturePart.Clone() (null entries preserved as null). It is the mutation-boundary primitive so a viewport drag / in-progress edit operates on a scratch copy before commit. Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 42-55; CreatureDefinitionTests.Clone_ProducesEqualButIndependentParts; Clone_PreservesNullPartEntriesWithoutThrowing).
- CreaturePart is immutable-by-convention (callers replace instances wholesale via definition helpers rather than mutating a stored part's fields) so the single enforcement point stays at CreatureDefinition. Confirmed (CreaturePart.cs class docstring; clone-independence asserted in CreatureDefinitionTests).
- AddPart(CreaturePart) appends WITHOUT canonicalizing/validating — it is a plain data op; the canonicalizer/validator run at the mutation boundary one layer up. Throws Common.DomainException on null. Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 98-103).
- RemovePart(id) is linear scan removing only the FIRST match; skips null entries; returns false when Parts is null or id not found. Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 104-119; CreatureDefinitionTests.RemovePart_SkipsNullEntriesAndRemovesOnlyFirstDuplicate; RemovePart_ReturnsFalseForNullPartList).
- BodyId reserved constant = "body"; CurrentSchemaVersion = 2. Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 21-22).

## 2. ClonePartAsChild vs CloneAsDuplicate

- CreaturePart.Clone() copies Id, DisplayName, ParentId, PartType, Transform, Shape, Appearance, MirrorAcrossSymmetryPlane, and deep-clones Limb / MeshGeometry / ParentAttachment (null-safe). Confirmed (CreaturePart.cs 78-95; clone-independence tests).
- CreaturePart.CloneAsDuplicate() = Clone() then a FRESH Id via PartIdGenerator.CreateNew(). It does NOT change ParentId/Transform/ParentAttachment (those are still copied) — it is the pure 'duplicate with new id' primitive. Confirmed (CreaturePart.cs 97-110; CreatureDefinitionTests.CloneAsDuplicate_GeneratesNewId asserts new id + copied PartType).
- CreatureDefinition.ClonePartAsChild(sourceId, newParentId) (CC-029 'Add Child as Duplicate') returns a NEW part: it calls source.CloneAsDuplicate() (fresh Id) then explicitly overrides ParentId = newParentId, Transform = TransformData.Identity (identity placement relative to the new parent), ParentAttachment = null. Copied authoring props: PartType, Shape, Appearance, MirrorAcrossSymmetryPlane, DisplayName. No generated/runtime state copied; Shape/Appearance/Transform are value structs so the clone is independent by construction. Throws Common.DomainException if sourceId is not found. The returned part is NOT added to Parts — callers add via AddPart so the single mutation boundary stays authoritative. Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 112-155; CreatureDefinitionClonePartAsChildTests.*: copies authoring props, fresh identity, resets placement+attachment, leaves source+definition untouched, unknown-source throws, CloneThenAddPart_ProducesValidDefinition).
- Inference-to-note: 'parenting under the source itself' is legal at the data layer (ClonePartAsChild(source.Id, source.Id) is used in tests); the validation surface then must accept it (a clone under its own source is a normal child relationship, not a self-cycle, because cycle detection only flags when following ParentId reaches an already-visited id). Confirmed-adjacent: DefinitionValidatorLimbTests/DefinitionValidatorTests accept such trees; CloneThenAddPart_ProducesValidDefinition asserts IsValid for a Body+source+cloned-child-under-source.

## 3. PartIdGenerator

- Format: "part_" + 8 lowercase hex chars (4 random bytes via System.Random, thread-guarded by a lock), e.g. "part_4f9a1c02". Short deterministic prefix + random suffix (design doc SS2.2). Ids created once at creation time and never re-derived from list position. Confirmed (PartIdGenerator.cs 1-43).
- LooksValid(id): structural only — non-empty/non-whitespace AND StartsWith "part_" (ordinal). Does NOT confirm uniqueness within a definition; uniqueness is DefinitionValidator's whole-collection responsibility. Confirmed (PartIdGenerator.cs 31-43; ClonePartAsChild test asserts LooksValid on fresh ids).
- Note: hierarchy cycle-termination treats a parent equal to CreatureDefinition.BodyId ("body") as a root stop, and BodyId is a reserved, non-generated id, so the "part_" prefix is a real guard that authored parts cannot collide with "body". Confirmed (HierarchyIndex.HasParentCycle; DefinitionValidator reserved-id check).

## 4. Hierarchy index, cycle detection, reserved body

- CreaturePartHierarchyIndex(CreatureDefinition) is a TOLERANT, FIRST-WINS view over a DETACHED SNAPSHOT of definition.Parts taken at construction (CC-089 read-only aliasing). The index's Parts surface is a private copy wrapped in Array.AsReadOnly, so callers cannot mutate the definition through it, and later mutation of definition.Parts cannot change what the index reports. Confirmed (CreaturePartHierarchyIndex.cs 1-75; CreatureDefinitionTests.HierarchyIndex_Parts_IsDetachedSnapshotOfDefinition; HierarchyIndex_Parts_CannotBeMutatedThroughReadOnlyView).
- It keeps _firstById (first part wins per id), _childrenByParent (null ParentId grouped under empty-string key = implicit root; BodyId children also under their literal "body" key), _duplicateIds, HasNullEntries. Confirmed (source).
- TryResolve(id): resolves via first-wins map; false for null/empty id. FindPart(id) and GetChildren(parentId) and HasParentCycle on CreatureDefinition all delegate to a freshly built index (never cached), so there is exactly one place parent/child relationships are derived (explicit anti-caching rationale). Confirmed (CreatureDefinition.cs 56-95; CreatureDefinitionTests.FindPart_IsUnaffectedByListReordering; MalformedHierarchy_IsTotalAndPreservesDiagnostics).
- HasParentCycle(out partIdsInCycle): walks ParentId links from every part; stops when ParentId is null OR == CreatureDefinition.BodyId (root); reports a cycle when it revisits an already-visited id. Returns true if any cycle. Confirmed (CreaturePartHierarchyIndex.cs 107-140; CreatureDefinitionTests.HasParentCycle_DetectsSelfReference / _DetectsIndirectCycle / _FalseForValidTree).
- Reserved 'body' id: a part whose Id == CreatureDefinition.BodyId is an Error (ReservedPartId); a part whose ParentId == BodyId is treated as a direct Body child (root). A null ParentId is itself an Error (InvalidBodyParent: 'must be a descendant of the Body'). Confirmed (DefinitionValidator.ValidateDuplicateIds ~388-435; ValidateParentsAndCycles ~437-471; DefinitionValidatorTests.Validate_RejectsReservedBodyPartId; Validate_RejectsPartWithNoParent).

## 5. Validation surface

### Run order (DefinitionValidator.Validate, DefinitionValidator.cs 18-55) — Confirmed (code):
1 ValidateSchemaVersion
2 ValidateBody
3 ValidateBodyAppearance (CC-025)
4 ValidateBounds
5 ValidateGenerationBudget
6 ValidateDuplicateIds
7 ValidateParentsAndCycles
8 ValidatePartTypes
9 ValidateTransformsAndShapesAndAppearance
10 ValidateLimbChains
11 ValidateMeshGeometry (CC-031)
12 ValidateResolvedEnvelope (CC-050 / CC-056A / CC-089)
Validate(null) throws DomainException. Validator is pure-ish and NEVER repairs — only reports (definition-vs-validator invariant). Confirmed.

### Severity semantics (ValidationSeverity.cs) — Confirmed:
- Info=0: does not block generation; surfaced for awareness (e.g. 'unusually thin blend radius').
- Warning=1: does not block generation but flags likely-unintended state.
- Error=2: BLOCKS generation — a definition with any Error must not proceed to generation (SS2.4).
- In current validator code, every emitted issue is Error EXCEPT one Warning: LegFootChainMissingAnkleJoint (leg with a direct Foot child but only two limb joints). NO current validator check emits Info (the Info tier is defined but unused by DefinitionValidator today). Confirmed (grep: only one ValidationSeverity.Warning at DefinitionValidator.cs ~716; zero Info emissions).

### Aggregation / sorting (ValidationResult.cs) — Confirmed:
- IsValid == true iff there are NO Error-severity issues (Warning/Info do not block).
- Issues are sorted deterministically: OrderBy(PartId ?? '', Ordinal).ThenBy(Code).ThenBy(Severity) — satisfying 'validation failures are deterministic and order-independent' (reorder of Parts without semantic change yields same ordered issue list).
- ValidationIssue carries Severity, Code, optional PartId (null for definition-wide issues), Message. Generation must depend only on Severity/Code, never editor rendering. Confirmed.

### Complete ValidationCode inventory (ValidationCode.cs, 1-52), grouped by concern — Confirmed (enum) with per-code source/tests:

STRUCTURAL (definition-level):
- UnsupportedSchemaVersion (schema != 2) [stage1]
- InvalidBounds (Bounds not finite/positive)
- GenerationBudgetExceeded (voxel budget or non-positive/NaN VoxelsPerUnit)
- NullPart (null Parts list or null part entry)
- DuplicatePartId (duplicate or null/empty part Id)
- ReservedPartId (Id == "body")
- MissingParent (ParentId references a non-resolved id)
- ParentCycle
- UnsupportedPartType (undefined enum OR Body/Root reserved in schema v2)
- InvalidBodyParent (null ParentId, or independent root Tail)
- MissingBody (no non-empty Body spline)

BODY:
- MissingBody
- InvalidBodySampleCount (> MaxBodySampleCount)
- DuplicateBodySampleId (duplicate OR non-increasing across spline order)
- InvalidBodySample (null sample, or non-finite position / non-positive radius)
- UnevenBodySpacing (arc-length spacing deviates > tolerance)
- InvalidForward (non-finite or ~zero)
- InvalidBodyAppearance (null appearance/curve/gradient, or no valid key in [0,1])
- NonFiniteBodyAppearance (non-finite curve/gradient key/tangent/value)
- InvalidAttachmentAnchor (non-finite or out-of-range SegmentT; references a non-segment-start/terminal Body sample)

LIMB:
- InvalidLimbChain (limb chain present on a non-limb PartType; null/no joints; null joint; null thickness)
- LimbJointCountOutOfRange (below Min or above Max)
- LegFootChainMissingAnkleJoint (WARNING only)
- DuplicateLimbJointId
- LimbJointOrderNotDeterministic (ids must increase with chain order)
- NonFiniteLimbJoint
- LimbSegmentTooShort (< MinLimbSegmentLength)
- LimbJointOutOfBounds (local-frame)
- LimbRootNotAtOrigin (Joints[0] must sit at local origin)
- InvalidThicknessProfile (null, <2 keys, duplicate/out-of-range T, non-positive value)
- NonFiniteThickness
- InvalidLimbBlendRadius (NaN/Inf or negative)

MESH (CC-031):
- InvalidMeshGeometry (empty MeshAssetKey; limb+mesh both present — exactly one geometry source; null attachment)
- NonFiniteMeshGeometryAttachment
- InvalidMeshGeometryScale (scale component < minimum)

RESOLVED (CC-050 envelope, stage 12, skips when a structural MissingParent/ParentCycle error exists):
- ResolvedBodySampleOutOfBounds
- ResolvedPartOutOfBounds
- ResolvedLimbJointOutOfBounds
- ResolvedMeshAttachmentOutOfBounds

Each code is asserted by a named test in DefinitionValidatorTests.cs / DefinitionValidatorLimbTests.cs / DefinitionValidatorMeshGeometryTests.cs (Confirmed by matching test method names, e.g. Validate_DetectsDuplicateIds, Validate_DetectsParentCycle, Validate_LimbWithDuplicateJointIds_ReportsDuplicateLimbJointId, Validate_EmptyMeshAssetKey_ReportsInvalidMeshGeometry).

### Notable invariants worth remembering
- Geometry sources are mutually exclusive per part: at most ONE of Shape (primitive SDF) / LimbChain (joint metaballs) / MeshGeometry (pre-authored mesh) is generation-active; Shape is inert for limb and mesh parts, so shape-parameter validity is skipped for them. Validator-enforced (InvalidMeshGeometry for limb+mesh; InvalidShapeParameter only when Limb==null && MeshGeometry==null). Confirmed.
- Resolved-envelope stage consumes the SHARED ResolvedBody / ResolvedLimb / CreaturePartWorldTransformResolver derivations (never re-derives), so it checks exactly the joint/position data generation uses; world-frame resolver throws on DNA that failed validation, hence the stage's early skip on structural parent defects. Confirmed (DefinitionValidator.cs 57-178; source comments CC-056A/CC-089).
- Mirroring does NOT cascade to children (per-part MirrorAcrossSymmetryPlane only) — consistent with 'one mutation path'. Confirmed (README ~295-307).

## Open questions / notes (not asserted as fact)
- ValidationSeverity.Info has no emitting check today; if a future 'thin blend radius' advisory is added it would be the first Info use. Inference.
- Whether an independent root (null ParentId) is ever intended for non-Tail parts: validator rejects ANY null ParentId as InvalidBodyParent (all parts must descend from Body). Inference that the model is strict single-root.
- This record is a DRAFT; see track1/NOTES.md for ingest caveats (the MemorySmith store schema also lists a required 'relationships' array; the draft omits it per mandate and it should be added as [] at ingest).
